room_rent.note: Optional 'Room Type Modifier' add-on can downgrade to twin-sharing for a premium discount. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU charges covered; no separate sub-limit stated. Proportionate deductions not applicable for ICU.

copayment.note: 10% co-pay for non-network hospitals; additional 10% for insured above 60 years on all claims; 10% if lower-zone insured treated in Zone A hospital. Green Channel benefit adds 5% co-pay if not treated at Green Channel hospital.

sub_limits.note: Sub-limits apply to listed surgeries/medical procedures as per Annexure attached to policy schedule. Cataract capping available as optional cover. Domiciliary capped at 10% of BSI. Bariatric surgery capped at Annual SI.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible in base plan. Voluntary deductible available as optional cover for premium discount.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Base plan: 36 months. Optional 'PED Protector' add-on (only at inception, below age 50) can reduce to 12 or 24 months.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions (cataract, hernia, BPH, joint replacement, etc.). Optional add-on can reduce to 12 months.

maternity.note: Maternity cover available as paid optional add-on; 24-month waiting period (reducible to 12 months via further optional add-on); limited to 2 deliveries/terminations lifetime; limit as per policy schedule; female insured age 18–50.

cumulative_bonus.display: As per plan opted (rate/max not specified in wording)
cumulative_bonus.note: CB accrues every policy year irrespective of claims; maximum cap as per plan opted. Super Booster optional add-on gives 100%/yr up to 500% (no-claim years only).

restoration.note: Triggered unlimited times for any illness/injury; not for first claim of year; not for same illness/related complications within 45 days; not available with Unlimited Claim option; unutilized amount lapses at year end.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation period not explicitly stated in wording; referred to as 'period as mentioned in the Schedule'.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation period not explicitly stated in wording; referred to as 'period as mentioned in the Schedule'.

day_care.note: Comprehensive list of 140 day-care procedures covered; also covers other day-care procedures not explicitly listed.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered up to 10% of Basic Sum Insured per policy year; several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.).

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to Basic Sum Insured; minimum 24-hour hospitalisation required; OPD/day-care AYUSH excluded.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor's in-patient medical expenses for harvesting covered up to amount in schedule; screening, pre/post-hospitalisation of donor excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to amount specified in policy schedule. Air ambulance (Emergency Domestic Medical Evacuation) available as optional add-on up to BSI.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern/technological treatments covered including robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy, etc.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable expenses (Annexure-A items) covered via optional 'Zero Deduct Cover' add-on; within Basic Sum Insured; not applicable for Global Cover.

global_cover.note: Global Cover for Emergency Hospitalisation available as optional add-on; 24-month waiting period; up to age 65; emergency in-patient only; max 60 consecutive days; within BSI limit.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration credits), no claim can be contested except on grounds of fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/quarterly/half-yearly premium; 15 days for monthly instalment. Coverage not available during grace period unless premium paid in instalments.

free_look.note: Applicable only for new individual health insurance policies; not on renewals or policies with tenure less than 1 year.

portability.note: IRDAI-compliant portability; apply at least 30 days before renewal; accrued waiting period credits transferred.

notable_exclusions.display: STDs/HIV, dental (non-accident), external congenital anomaly, spectacles/hearing aids, external prosthetics/devices, RMO/surcharges, self-inflicted injury, war

optional_riders.display: Zero Deduct, Maternity, Global Cover, Super Booster, Unlimited Claim, PED Protector, OPD Cover, Voluntary Co-pay/Deductible, Air Ambulance, EMI Protector, Vector Borne, Pause the Age
